info.name: Senior Connect API
info.description:
Backend REST API for the Senior Connect / Activity Together platform — Mobile App + Admin Dashboard.

NestJS + TypeScript + MongoDB (Mongoose). Field names follow the Figma designs exactly.

## Every example in this collection is real

Each saved example below was captured by actually calling a running instance of this API.
Nothing here is hand-written or invented: the ids, timestamps, JWTs, counts and error
messages are the bytes the server returned during one end-to-end run, in which two real
accounts were registered and verified by OTP, created and joined activities, favourited,
blocked, and were moderated by the seeded admin.

**The people in the examples**

| Role | Name | Email | Password |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Organizer | Arthur Baumann | `arthur.baumann.2421164@example.com` | `Sunrise2026` |
| Participant | Marguerite Favre | `marguerite.favre.2421164@example.com` | `Lakeside2026` |
| Admin (seeded) | Admin | `admin@contenthub.io` | `admin123` |

Arthur also registered the phone `+41 792421164`
(E.164 `+41792421164`), which is a login identifier in its own right.

## Environments

`{{baseUrl}}` points at the deployment: `https://jakuan3500.syedbipul.me/api/v1`.
Switch it to `{{baseUrlLocal}}` (`http://localhost:5000/api/v1`) to run against a local
server, or `{{baseUrlLive}}` for the Vercel deployment. Nothing else needs changing —
every request in this collection is written against `{{baseUrl}}`.

## Running locally

1. `cd senior-connect-api && docker compose up -d` — MongoDB 7 as a single-node replica set on port 27018.
2. `npm run seed` — 13 Figma categories + the admin above.
3. `npm run start:dev`, then set `{{baseUrl}}` to `{{baseUrlLocal}}`.
   If your `.env` sets `PORT`, point `{{baseUrlLocal}}` at that port instead.

## Order to run in

Run **Auth (Admin) → Admin Login** and **Auth (Mobile) → Login** first — their test scripts
capture `{{accessToken}}`, `{{refreshToken}}`, `{{adminAccessToken}}` and `{{userId}}` for you.
Then **Categories → List Categories** fills `{{categoryId}}`, `{{categoryId2}}`, `{{categoryId3}}`,
and **Activities → Create Activity** fills `{{activityId}}`.

## Conventions

- Every response uses the envelope `{ success, message, data }`, plus `meta`
  (`{ page, limit, total, totalPages }`) on paginated lists.
- Auth is a JWT bearer token; the collection sends `{{accessToken}}` by default and
  admin folders override it with `{{adminAccessToken}}`.
- Ids are Mongo ObjectIds.
- Passwords are minimum 6 characters, with no maximum.
- OTPs are 6 digits and expire in 5 minutes. In dev, with no SMTP/Twilio configured,
  they are printed to the server console as `[DEV] OTP for <identifier>`.
- There is a 60 second cooldown per identifier between OTP requests, plus per-IP
  hourly and daily caps — a 429 here is the limiter, not a bug.

item.name: Auth (Mobile)
item.description:
Registration, OTP verification, sign-in and the password lifecycle.

Email and phone are both first-class login identifiers. Register accepts both; login, verify-otp, resend-otp, forgot-password and reset-password each take exactly one.

request.description:
Figma "Create Account". Supply an email, a phone (`phoneCountryCode` + `phoneNumber`), or both — registering with both is the normal mobile path and each identifier is verified by its own OTP. `acceptTerms` must be `true`; the password is minimum 6 characters.

The response reports which channels a code went out on.
